name: bash
arguments:
{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
invoice=[(2,240),(3,240),(4,240)]
purchase=[(2,175),(3,175),(4,175)]
inv_sub=sum(Decimal(q)*Decimal(p) for q,p in invoice)
pur_sub=sum(Decimal(q)*Decimal(p) for q,p in purchase)
print("Invoice lines:")
for q,p in invoice: print(f"  {q} x {p} = {Decimal(q)*Decimal(p)}")
print("Invoice subtotal:", inv_sub, "=", int(inv_sub*100), "cents")
print("(Purchase lines excluded subtotal:", pur_sub, ")")
limit=Decimal("1800.00")
print("Approved limit:", limit, "=", int(limit*100), "cents")
print("Subtotal exceeds limit by:", inv_sub-limit)
print("Half-even(2,160.005 ->", Decimal("2160.005").quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN), ") demo")
PY"}
